original_test_intent: Verify approved RDIMM type, count, capacity, slot1-24 population and topology across BIOS and Linux, and reconcile installed capacity with Linux total/available/free accounting.
original_method: Operator captures BIOS memory topology and every slot; agent securely collects full Type17 DMI, meminfo, free and NUMA/topology with empty/populated slots; engineer maps part/serial/type/size/speed/ECC/locator and accounts for reserved memory.
manual_activity: Operator/KVM captures BIOS slots1-24; agent may securely collect Linux memory evidence after approved boot.
required_inputs: Approved board/BIOS and RDIMM part/serial/type/rank/capacity/speed/ECC population matrix
Qualified operator/KVM and BIOS slot mapping
Expected installed capacity and Linux reserved/usable/available/free comparison policy
Secure Linux access with dmidecode/proc/free/NUMA tools
ECC/SEL/thermal abort and hardware recovery policy
safety_requirements: Read-only inspection only; no DIMM reseat or BIOS memory changes
Preserve empty slots and error/unknown records
Stop on wrong host, unstable boot, ECC/SEL error or contradictory topology
agent_execution_scope: Collect full DMI Type17, meminfo, free and NUMA/topology
Do not perform physical/BIOS actions, filter away slots, assume equality or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Ensure BIOS evidence and resolve discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial only: DMI is relevant but unsafe SSH and installed-only filtering omit BIOS/empty-slot/accounting coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After manual BIOS capture, securely collect complete `dmidecode -t memory`, `/proc/meminfo`, `free -b/-h` and NUMA/topology outputs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: RDIMM, slots1-24, BIOS/Linux checks, count/size/accounting and1/1 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reconcile signed BIOS slot map with unfiltered Type17 records and explicit Linux memory accounting.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds part-level provenance, empty slots, NUMA/ECC context, secure collection and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: DMI installed-only output cannot prove slots1-24 or Linux usable memory criteria.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware-reserved memory, kernel overhead, hugepages and timing can make installed, total, available and free values differ.

project_override_considerations: Project must define acceptable reserved-memory delta and comparison units/timestamps; literal textual equality is not assumed.
expected_evidence: BIOS Memory Topology screenshots for slots1-24
Full Type17 including empty/populated slots and part/serial/type/speed/ECC/locator

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: RDIMM topology/count/size and Linux accounting intent is consistent. Exact population and comparison policy are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator/KVM, spec and Linux tools can be supplied; hybrid inspection is feasible.

review_improvement: Restores BIOS slots1-24 and Linux accounting coverage that the DMI-only prior review omitted.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type17 records establish firmware-reported devices and locators but not the physical BIOS screen or Linux allocator view. `MemTotal`, `MemAvailable` and `free` columns have defined but different meanings, and reserved memory makes installed capacity larger than usable RAM. Comparison must be time- and unit-aligned rather than a simplistic equality claim.
